risk_note: RV2 ledger admin adjustment (FU-ADJUST-REFS-UUID-CASE, the B2-12c money r1 S2). refsShapeOk compared ref_id as submitted while checkRefs looked recon_diff, withdrawal and account_deletion up in lower case, so one document written in both letter cases was accepted and stored twice. Now the duplicate key lower-cases those three types (refDedupeKey) and compares order ids exactly (order_key is case-sensitive). Only the comparison changes: stored refs stay as submitted, and the check order, error codes, vouchers, audit and balances are untouched. One response detail: two values of those types that differ only in case and are not UUIDs now get 20001 fields=[refs] at the duplicate check instead of 20001 reason=adjust_ref_invalid later. Integration refs-case plus the frozen admin-adjustments directories 146/146. The rule-test unit run had 4 boot-the-app tests time out at 15 s under load (no assertion failed); run alone with a longer timeout 17/17.
